Apps for people who love food, travel and money

No subscriptions, no ads, no nonsense. Just useful tools made for people like you.

🧳 Travel
Gulliver Travels
Your personal travel command center

A trip organizer that turns your confirmation emails into a clean, day-by-day itinerary automatically. Build out your travel plans, track every reservation, and curate a personal restaurant database for every destination you visit.

Open app ↗
Upcoming trips
Trip itinerary
Restaurant database
Travel stats
What it does
  • Forward booking emails or even photos of a reservation and Gulliver Travels automatically places them in your itinerary — flights, hotels, restaurants, and more
  • Day-by-day view with weather, TSA wait times, and airport info
  • Share and sync trips with travel companions
  • Easily create and share a curated list of your favorite restaurants for any destination
  • Packing helper — get a smart packing list tailored to your trip and destinations
  • Subscribe to a calendar feed so your trips show up in Apple Calendar or Google Calendar automatically
How to get started
  1. 1Go to gullivertravels.app and sign up with your Google account or email address.
  2. 2Once you're in, add your first trip — give it a name and travel dates.
  3. 3Forward any booking confirmation email to GulliverTravelsPlans@gmail.com and watch it appear in your itinerary automatically.
  4. 4Explore the trip view — check weather, nearby places, and share your itinerary with anyone traveling with you.
  5. 5Add Gulliver Travels to your phone's home screen — tap Share then "Add to Home Screen" on iPhone, or the menu on Android. It'll open full-screen just like a native app.
🍽️ Food
Nightly Bites
A meal journal for people who love food

Track the meals you've made, save recipes you love, and get dinner ideas when you're drawing a blank. Built for a small group — everyone's entries are shared, so it becomes a living record of meals enjoyed together.

Open app ↗
What it does
  • Log meals with photos, ratings, and notes
  • Community Cookbook — recipes anyone in the group has saved, all in one place
  • Paste a recipe URL and a clean, formatted version is saved instantly
  • Dinner suggestion feature — tell it what's in your fridge, get ideas back
  • Your personal recipe box for anything you want to keep handy
How to get started
  1. 1Go to nightly-bites-web.vercel.app and sign up with your Google account or email address.
  2. 2Log your first meal — add a photo, a rating, and a few notes about what you made or ate.
  3. 3Browse the Community Cookbook to see what others in the group have been cooking and saving.
  4. 4Try the recipe saver — paste any recipe URL and it'll be cleaned up and added to your recipe box instantly.
  5. 5Add Nightly Bites to your home screen — tap Share then "Add to Home Screen" on iPhone, or the menu on Android. It opens full-screen with no browser in the way.
💳 Finance
Point-Taken
Know exactly where your money goes

A personal finance tracker that connects securely to your bank accounts and credit cards, automatically syncing transactions so you always have a clear picture of your spending.

Open app ↗
Transactions
Card benefits tracker
Recurring charges
What it does
  • All credit card and bank transactions merged into a single unified view — one place to search and find any charge
  • Clean spending breakdown by category, merchant, and card
  • Tracks your credit card benefits — which perks are available and which you've already used
  • Track recurring expenses to monitor subscriptions
  • "Which card should I use?" — recommendations based on your actual cards and rewards
How to get started
  1. 1Go to point-taken-tan.vercel.app and sign up with your Google account or email address.
  2. 2Create a SimpleFIN account ($1.50/month or $15/year) — this is the secure bridge that connects your banks without sharing your passwords.
  3. 3In SimpleFIN, connect your banks and credit cards, then generate a setup token and paste it into Point-Taken. One-time setup.
  4. 4Your transactions will start syncing automatically. Explore your spending breakdown, set up your cards, and check which benefits you still have available.
  5. 5Add Point-Taken to your home screen — tap Share then "Add to Home Screen" on iPhone, or the menu on Android — for quick access anytime you want to check your spending.

🍷 Wine
Bottle Notes
Scan a label, build your cellar

Point your camera at any wine label and the details are pulled in automatically — vintner, grapes, origin, vintage, and more. Log tasting notes, track bottles you own, and build a searchable record of everything you've tried.

Open app ↗
Wine collection & tastings
Wine details
Where it comes from
What it does
  • Scan any wine label with your phone camera — name, vintner, grapes, origin, and alcohol pulled in automatically
  • Add tasting notes, a rating, and where you tried it
  • Track your collection — bottles owned, quantities, and a "Drink a bottle" flow to keep counts accurate
  • Want to Try list for wines you've heard about but haven't opened yet
  • Searchable history of every wine you've logged
How to get started
  1. 1Go to wine-tasting-six.vercel.app and sign up with your Google account or email address.
  2. 2Tap the scan button, point your camera at a wine label, and let it do its thing.
  3. 3Add your notes — where you had it, what you thought, how you'd rate it.
  4. 4Add Bottle Notes to your home screen — tap Share then "Add to Home Screen" on iPhone, or the menu on Android — so it's always handy at a restaurant or a shop.
🌱 Gardening
Hazel's Garden By request
Plan, grow, and track your garden — season by season

A garden planning and tracking app named after the real head of the operation. Map out your plots, log your harvests, journal what's growing, and get AI-powered plant advice when something looks off. Built for serious home gardeners who want to remember what worked.

What it does
  • Visual garden map — lay out your plots, assign what you're growing, and track planting dates
  • Harvest log with running totals by variety, so you always know what produced well
  • Photo journal — attach pictures to any entry and track how things are progressing
  • AI plant advisor — describe a problem or snap a photo and get a diagnosis with next steps
  • Shared gardens — invite others to view or co-manage a garden with you
  • Year-over-year history so you can rotate crops and learn from past seasons
How to get access
Hazel's Garden is available by request. If you're interested, reach out to jabaskes@gmail.com and Jeremy will get you set up.
✈️ Travel
Traveling Sibs Private
Know when everyone's out of town

A shared away-date tracker for a small group of siblings. Everyone logs their travel windows, and the whole thing syncs automatically to each person's Google Calendar — no imports, no manual updates.

What it does
  • Simple date-range entry — add a from/to date and an optional label like "beach trip"
  • Combined view of all siblings' away dates, color-coded by person
  • Personalized Google Calendar feed — subscribe once and it auto-refreshes, showing only the others' dates so there's no duplication
  • Private app — login required, accounts by invitation only
How to get access
Traveling Sibs is a private app. If you received an invite from Jeremy, reach out to jabaskes@gmail.com to get set up.
